coverage_breadth.definition: per study month, the number of assets with at least one klines observation inside that UTC month across the declared inventory (coverage accounting only; not a signal, state or outcome)

method: Re-fetch of exactly the 644 H49-pinned wave-A archives (each byte string must hash to the H49-recorded sha256) followed by read-only normalization into 14 DISP-003-schema panels: content re-validation, source-month UTC window restriction, exact row accounting, no interpolation/backfill, plus descriptive per-month coverage breadth over the declared panel inventory.
network_io: 644 pinned keyless GETs to data.binance.vision only
non_claims: A normalized panel is not market evidence and is not an economic result.
No returns, spreads, dispersion states, p-values, costs or inference computed.
No candidate promoted; no confirmatory claim; H10 gate unchanged and date-gated to 2026-11-30.
Breadth counts are coverage accounting, not point-in-time rank truth and not an eligibility claim.
Wave B (ARK/ASTR) and excluded ALPHA are out of scope; no wave-B or extra month fetched.
Malformed, missing or digest-mismatched archives are reported, never interpolated, backfilled or forward-filled.
The re-fetch reproduces the already-completed H49 acquisition; it is not a new attempt at a failed gate and is not fresh mechanism evidence.
Does not alter any frozen DISP-001/002/003 artifact, config, ledger, committed panel or forward block.
A green test suite proves only what the tests cover.
verdict_rule: SCOPE_MISMATCH on any pinned-digest, asset-set, month-set, URL-base or panel-count failure; INCOMPLETE on any fetch/digest/content failure, uncovered month, out-of-window row, duplicate timestamp or row-identity failure; COMPLETE only when all 644 H49 archives reconcile into 14 panels.
